title: Off-White Embroidered Cotton Kurta Set for Women with Cutwork Organza Dupatta
color_custom: Off-white with blush pink & grey floral embroidery
description:
Some pieces never go out of style. This off-white kurta set is soft as a morning in Jaipur – scattered with delicate blush-pink and grey floral embroidery and finished with a scalloped cutwork organza dupatta. Effortless at a puja, polished at the office and beautiful at a day wedding.

✦ The Details
• Straight-cut kurta with band collar and slit neckline with grey piping
• Floral thread embroidery on the front, back and sleeves
• Matching straight pants with a scalloped cutwork hem
• Sheer organza dupatta with matching embroidery and scalloped cutwork edge
• Calf-length kurta with side slits
• 3-piece set: kurta, pants and dupatta

✦ Fabric & Craft
The kurta and pants are cotton flex – a soft, slub-textured cotton that drapes well and stays breathable through long days. The dupatta is lightweight organza that holds its shape and catches the light beautifully in photos.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit that skims the body. Choose your usual size, or use our Fit Finder for a recommendation. Between sizes? Size up for a relaxed look – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your exact measurements at no extra cost.

✦ How to Style It
Keep it soft with pearl-detail heels, silver jhumkas and a nude lip. For evening, switch to statement chandbalis and a metallic potli. Abroad, it pairs beautifully with a beige trench coat for autumn functions.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in our own Jaipur unit – we send you photos of your piece being made
• Free custom fit – share your measurements and we stitch it for you
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen. Model is wearing size S.
care: Dry clean recommended for the first wash, then gentle hand wash in cold water. Do not wring or bleach. Dry in shade and iron on the reverse side, avoiding the embroidery.
